company.name: Olymon
company.shortDescription: Olymon is an e-commerce automation tool for the retail industry.
company.description: Olymon is a retail technology and e-commerce automation platform that helps merchants synchronize and manage operations between their physical stores and online sales channels. Functioning as middleware between point-of-sale (POS) systems and digital commerce platforms, Olymon enables retailers to automate critical operational workflows and maintain real-time business visibility.

insights.statement: The latest disclosed Angel round raised $5,000, or 16.39% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.statement: 1 disclosed grants total $25,500, representing 83.61% of reported funding.
insights.implication: The grants reduce the share of reported financing attributed to equity or notes, although their restrictions and milestone requirements need separate verification.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $3,005,000 to $3,005,000, a 1x increase.
